scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @job-assistant/autofill-contracts build && node scripts/build-autofill.mjs && node src/index.js
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @job-assistant/autofill-contracts build && node scripts/build-autofill.mjs && prisma generate --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma && node --check src/index.js
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @job-assistant/autofill-contracts build && node scripts/build-autofill.mjs && node --check src/index.js && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @job-assistant/autofill-contracts build && node scripts/build-autofill.mjs && node tests/integration.mjs
